trophies.guide: This is the platinum trophy for the full list. Per the official description, it marks becoming a Leonida Legend, which means earning every other trophy in this guide. Work through the roadmap stages in order and use the checklist filters to find anything still missing.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: The official description says to complete Gone Fishing. Play the main story until that mission becomes available, then finish it to the end. Story mission trophies like this one are earned simply by progressing.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: The official description says to complete Chapter 1. Keep following the story markers until the chapter ends and the game moves you into the next chapter. This cannot be missed if you keep playing the story.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: The official description says to complete Chapter 2. Continue the main story missions in order until Chapter 2 is finished. Like the other chapter trophies, this is earned through normal story progress.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: The official description says to complete Chapter 3. Stay on the main story path and finish every required mission in that chapter. The trophy pops when the chapter is complete.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: The official description says to complete Chapter 4. Play through the story missions of Chapter 4 until the game advances past it. This is a story progress trophy and is not missable.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: The official description says to complete the final mission. Finish the main story to its ending. After the credits you can keep playing in free roam to clean up everything else for the platinum.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: The official description says to complete Breakfast Run. Play the story until this named mission appears, then complete it. Named mission trophies are earned by finishing that mission.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: The official description says to complete The Cartel Heist. Reach this heist mission through story progress and finish it. Prepare by keeping weapons and health stocked before starting major story missions.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: The official description says to complete Child's Play. Follow the story until this mission unlocks, then play it to completion. This is a straightforward story trophy.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: The official description says to complete Headliners. Progress through the main story to reach this mission and finish it. No side activity is required for this one beyond story progress.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: The official description says to complete VCIA Takedown. Play the story until this mission is available and complete it. VCIA also appears in another trophy description, so keep an eye on airport-related story beats.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: The official description says to complete Operation Savage Glory. Reach this operation through the main story and finish the mission. Story trophies unlock automatically on completion.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The official description says to attain 100% Completion. This is the long cleanup trophy: finish the story, strands, collectibles, and activities tracked in this guide. Use the in-game completion tracker to see what percentage remains and work category by category.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: The official description says to complete 250 Stunts. Stunts are driving challenges scattered around Leonida; each completed stunt counts toward the total. This is a grind trophy best chipped away at during free roam between story missions.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The official description says to try each type of activity once. Visit every activity type the game offers at least one time. You do not need to master them here, just sample each one.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: The official description says to earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. Complete every shooting range challenge and replay any that fall short of gold. Practice with each weapon type to learn the scoring targets.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: The official description says to win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Find each drone race location and win at least once at each. Keep a note of which locations you have already won.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: The official description says to win 20 different races. Winning the same race repeatedly does not help; you need twenty distinct race wins. Use a fast, upgraded vehicle and learn the shortcuts on each course.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: The official description says to beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge activity and out-fish him. If you lose, retry the challenge until you win.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: The official description says to complete an arcade game. Play any in-game arcade machine through to completion. This is one of the quickest activity trophies in the list.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: The official description says to complete the final mission for Andy. Work through Andy's mission strand in order until his final mission unlocks, then finish it. Strands are side storylines separate from the main chapters.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: The official description says to complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's strand missions in sequence and complete the last one. Check your map for Kenton's markers when they appear.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: The official description says to complete the final mission for Billy. Play through Billy's mission strand until the final mission is available, then finish it. Completing each named strand feeds into the Strangers & Freaks trophy.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: The official description says to complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. The named strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, and Tyrone in this list count toward this total. Keep exploring for stranger markers until eight strands are done.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: The official description says to complete the final mission for Randy. Work through Randy's strand in order and finish his last mission. Each completed strand also progresses the Strangers & Freaks trophy.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: The official description says to complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's missions in sequence until the finale unlocks, then complete it. Strand finales each have their own trophy like this one.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: The official description says to meditate at every spot across Leonida. This is a collectible-style sweep: find each meditation spot and use it once. Sweep region by region so you do not miss a spot.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: The official description says to hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take on Bret's hunting request and track down the unique animal he asks for. Follow the activity markers to the hunting area.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: The official description says to complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Collectible cards are hidden around Leonida and grouped into sets; finish three full sets. Track sets in the collectibles menu to see which cards remain.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: The official description says to WAiNK It at 100 locations. This is a location collectible: use the WAiNK action at one hundred different spots. Do these opportunistically while exploring for other collectibles.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: The official description says to complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are tracked objectives in the game menu; complete any fifty of them. Sort by easiest first to build momentum.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: The official description says to lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape. Raise your wanted level to four stars while together, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the heat clears. Coordinate so both of you survive the escape.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: The official description says to rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Plan a route between nearby shops and keep the wanted level active between robberies. If the heat drops, restart the chain.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: The official description says to discover 100 vehicles. Enter or encounter one hundred different vehicle types around Leonida. New vehicles appear as you unlock areas, so this fills in naturally during exploration.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: The official description says to take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus when at least five enemies are in range and take them all down before it ends. Busy story shootouts are good opportunities.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: The official description says to make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Because this is tied to a specific airport moment in the story, treat it as missable: if the story moves past the VCIA sequence, you may need mission replay or a new save. Try for it when the story first takes you to VCIA.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The official description is cryptic: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are tanks, so this likely involves a specific Rhino encounter. Because tank access may be limited to particular missions, treat this as missable and attempt it whenever a Rhino is available.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: The official description says to rob a jewelry store without being detected. Approach stealthily and complete the robbery before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: The official description says to rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Each successful vault robbery with an escape counts toward the five. Stock up on health and ammo before each attempt.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: The official description says to rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck in free roam, rob it, and lose the wanted level. A fast getaway vehicle parked nearby helps.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: The official description says to explore all of Leonida. Uncover the full map by visiting every region of the state. Flying over unexplored areas is an efficient way to fill in the map.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: The official description says to rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Find one illegal operation per gang and rob each of them. Track which gangs you have already hit so none are missed.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The official description says to enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The name suggests an early-game moment, so treat this as missable: try it when you first reach Ocean Beach. If the opportunity is tied to an early scene, it may not return later.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The official description says to smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. This sounds like a specific showroom escape moment, likely during a mission. Treat it as missable and attempt it whenever the story puts you inside a showroom.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The official description says to follow-through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Visit that bowling alley and complete the bowling activity there. The phrase follow-through is a hint to finish your bowling action properly.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: The official description is vague: A partnership with mass appeal. This appears to be a partner-related trophy, so play partner activities and build your partnership. Check partner activities first when hunting this one.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: The official description says choices made (for better or worse). This is tied to story choices, which makes it potentially missable depending on what you pick. Keep a manual save before major story decisions so you can revisit choices.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: The official description says second time's the charm. This suggests failing or retrying something specific a second time. Because it depends on a particular situation, treat it as missable and keep saves around major missions.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: The official description asks what the hell just happened, pointing to a strange scripted moment. Hidden story moments like this are easy to walk past, so treat it as missable. Explore unusual locations and events when the game hints at them.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The official description says to bowl them over with a melee drive-by. Perform a melee attack from a moving vehicle and hit targets. Practice in a quiet street until the timing feels right.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: The official description says to earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills whenever your contacts offer the option until the total reaches $250,000. This is an economy grind best done alongside other cleanup.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: The official description says to spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothing, weapons, and upgrades until your total shop spending reaches $100,000. Save this for late game when money is plentiful.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: The official description says to purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property available for purchase in Leonida. This needs a lot of money, so finish money-making activities first.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The official description says to register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the in-game Scooter Bros app to register ten different vehicles. Any vehicles you own or steal can be registered until you hit ten.
trophies.name: On the Spot
